name: Tenniscafe Edelweiss
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Tenniscafe Edelweiss in Telfs!**

Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, our cozy café offers the perfect blend of sport, relaxation, and local charm. Whether you're here to enjoy a refreshing break after a game of tennis or simply to savor our delicious treats, we’re your ideal spot.

**Indulge in our homemade specialties:**
- **Kaiserschmarrn** – fluffy, caramelized, and served with fresh fruit or a dusting of powdered sugar.
- **Apfelstrudel** – warm, spiced apple pastry with a hint of cinnamon.
- **Tiroler Gröstl** – hearty potato pancakes with crispy bacon, onions, and a fried egg on top.

Pair your meal with a **Tiroler Bergkäse** (Tyrolean alpine cheese) platter or a frothy **Schnaps** for the true alpine experience. Our café also serves freshly brewed coffee, smoothies, and a selection of cold drinks to keep you energized.

**Perfect for:**
✔ Tennis players & clubs (book a court nearby!)
✔ Families & groups (spacious seating & outdoor terrace)
✔ Travelers exploring the **Inntal** or **Lech-Zamms** region

**Location:**
📍 **Telfs**, right by the tennis courts – easy access from the **A12** or **Innsbruck** (just 15 minutes away).

**Visit us today and experience the best of **Tirol**’s hospitality!**

---
*Open daily | Outdoor seating available | Free Wi-Fi | Cash & card accepted*
